id: 32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he
title: 激光焊接机红色定位点的校准
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/32_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder - Calibrate the red spot position for the welding he/src.py

points.K1: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
points.K3: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
points.K4: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
points.K5: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
points.K6: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
points.S3: 校准时焊枪固定在支架上
points.S4: 喷嘴发烫变色，立即停机

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指着焊嘴下方的一个小红点
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a small red dot on the work surface below a welding gun nozzle.
shots.narration: 这一课讲焊枪红色定位点的校准。
overlay: 激光焊接机红色定位点的校准

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在手机上看视频，屏幕上出现一串数字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches a tutorial video on his phone; a row of blurred digits appears on the phone screen.
shots.narration: 阿杰在教程视频里看到了管理员密码。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰走到焊接机前，想自己进设置改参数
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks to the laser welding machine, ready to open the settings on the touch screen.
shots.narration: 他想自己进设置，调一调参数。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师摇头，指向墙上空白的设备管理制度
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes her head and points at a blank equipment rules poster on the wall.
shots.narration: 王老师拦住他：这项设置不是谁都能动。

shots.section_title: 出厂默认密码要改掉
shots.scene: 屏幕上的密码框，旁边一把锁和一把钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A password box on the touch screen shown as dots, with a padlock and a key beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 教程里的出厂密码，人人都看得到。

shots.section_title: 出厂默认密码要改掉
shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上设置新密码，王老师在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets a new hidden password on the touch screen while the safety administrator watches.
shots.narration: 设备到手，负责人就要改掉默认密码。

shots.section_title: 出厂默认密码要改掉
shots.scene: 密码写在纸条上贴在机器上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a password note stuck on the machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 新密码专人掌握，不贴、不外传。

shots.section_title: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
shots.scene: 焊嘴下，红点偏在焊丝的一侧
shots.prompt_en: Close view: below the nozzle the red dot falls to one side of the welding wire tip. No people.
shots.narration: 喷嘴装好了，红点仍偏在焊丝左边或右边，
overlay: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准

shots.section_title: 红点偏离焊丝左右时校准
shots.scene: 原装焊接嘴特写，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the original welding nozzle properly fitted, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 用的是原装焊接嘴，就做左右校准。

shots.section_title: 进入管理员设置
shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上依次点开设置菜单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps through blank menu items on the touch screen: settings, machine settings, administrator.
shots.narration: 在屏幕上进入系统设置、机器设置，

shots.section_title: 进入管理员设置
shots.scene: 密码键盘，输入的数字显示为圆点
shots.prompt_en: A numeric keypad on the touch screen with the entered digits shown only as dots. No people.
shots.narration: 再进管理员设置，由负责人输入密码。

shots.section_title: 改参数前后都要登记
shots.scene: 老李在空白记录本上写下参数原值
shots.prompt_en: Before changing anything, the facility engineer writes the current value into a blank equipment logbook.
shots.narration: 改参数之前，先记下原来的数值。

shots.section_title: 改参数前后都要登记
shots.scene: 记录本上一栏原值、一栏新值、一栏签名
shots.prompt_en: A blank logbook page with three columns marked by icons: old value, new value and signature. No people.
shots.narration: 改完再登记新值、日期和操作人。

shots.section_title: 改参数前后都要登记
shots.scene: 设置页顶部的红色提示条被放大
shots.prompt_en: The top of the settings page with a red warning banner magnified by a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 屏幕上的红色提示，要看清再动手。

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 老李点红点偏移右边的开始按钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps the start button next to the red dot offset item on the settings page.
shots.narration: 点红点偏移旁边的开始，
overlay: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 分屏：点左箭头红点左移，点右箭头红点右移
shots.prompt_en: Split view: tapping a left arrow moves the red dot left, tapping a right arrow moves it right. No people.
shots.narration: 左箭头红点左移，右箭头红点右移。

shots.section_title: 左右箭头调偏移，对准焊丝
shots.scene: 红点中心正好落在焊丝上，老李点完成
shots.prompt_en: The red dot center lands exactly on the wire; the facility engineer taps a completed button.
shots.narration: 红点中心落在焊丝上，点完成。

shots.section_title: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
shots.scene: 切割嘴剖面：光束打在喷嘴内壁上
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway diagram of a narrow cutting nozzle: the beam strikes the inner wall instead of passing through the center. No people.
shots.narration: 用切割嘴时，光可能打到喷嘴内壁，
overlay: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右

shots.section_title: 切割嘴光打内壁，先调左右
shots.scene: 内壁处出现堵塞和反射的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Small icons of a blockage and a reflected arrow appear at the nozzle's inner wall. No people.
shots.narration: 造成堵塞或反射，先做左右校准。

shots.section_title: 喷嘴发烫变色，立即停机
shots.scene: 喷嘴发红变色、冒烟的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a cutting nozzle glowing, discolored and giving off a wisp of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 使用中发现喷嘴发烫、变色、冒烟，
overlay: 喷嘴发烫变色，立即停机

shots.section_title: 喷嘴发烫变色，立即停机
shots.scene: 老李松开扳机，按下急停
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer releases the trigger and presses the red emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 立即停光停机，不要硬撑着继续用。

shots.section_title: 喷嘴发烫变色，立即停机
shots.scene: 老李在空白报修单上写字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fills in a blank repair report card.
shots.narration: 等冷却后检查，必要时报修。

shots.section_title: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
shots.scene: 屏幕上偏移数值框归零
shots.prompt_en: The offset value box on the settings screen is reset to zero. No people.
shots.narration: 还是不行，就把红点偏移归零，
overlay: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下

shots.section_title: 仍不行：偏移归零再调上下
shots.scene: 焊接嘴和清洗嘴的大孔径特写，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close views of a welding nozzle and a cleaning nozzle with wide openings, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 再调上下；焊接嘴清洗嘴孔大，一般不用。

shots.section_title: 校准时焊枪固定在支架上
shots.scene: 焊枪稳稳架在支架上，枪口朝下对着台面
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun rests firmly in its cradle with the nozzle pointing down at the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 调上下之前，焊枪架在支架上固定好。
overlay: 校准时焊枪固定在支架上

shots.section_title: 校准时焊枪固定在支架上
shots.scene: 屏幕出光开关关闭，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen shows the laser enable toggle switched off, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 出光使能保持关闭，只有定位红光。

shots.section_title: 校准时焊枪固定在支架上
shots.scene: 手握焊枪、手指在枪口前的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand holding the welding gun with fingers in front of the nozzle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手和脸都不要放在枪口前方。

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 老李把小内六角插进焊枪上的调节孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inserts a small hex key into an adjustment hole on the back of the welding gun in its cradle.
shots.narration: 内六角插进焊枪上的调节孔，
overlay: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 分屏：一边慢慢拧，一边散乱的红光逐渐汇成一点
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a hex key turns slowly while a scattered red glow gradually gathers into one dot. No people.
shots.narration: 一边慢慢拧，一边看喷嘴射出的红光。

shots.section_title: 内六角慢慢拧，红点清晰即停
shots.scene: 一个清晰的圆形红点，老李停手
shots.prompt_en: A sharp round red dot appears on the bench and the facility engineer stops turning.
shots.narration: 出现清晰的红点，就停。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands with icons behind: a padlock, a logbook, a gun in a cradle and a red dot.
shots.narration: 改密码，记参数，枪固定，红点准。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 阿杰把手机收起，向王老师点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts away his phone and nods to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：设置交给负责人。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 光点对准，安全对路。下次见！
